commands.installed_tests: outside checkout, after copying tests/scripts/forwarder without src: VENV_PYTHON -m pytest -q --junitxml=INSTALLED_RESULTS.xml tests

documentation_validation.historical_reference_scope: Parent-plan source excerpts may refer to the archived predecessor or external Rust checkout; these are provenance, not current Python implementation anchors.

limitations: All acceptance results are local Linux CPython 3.11.7. No macOS arm64, CPython 3.14, isolated dependency-lock matrix or constrained release host was executed.
Plan 12 paging retains independent resident manifest/receipt and encoded metadata limits; memory mode can refuse growth.
The synthetic 80-pair workflow forces 80 bundles and 80 parts per recovery to cross real ownership pages; it is not a greater-than-four-times-admitted-RAM measurement.

New benchmark measurements are tiny correctness/startup/tooling evidence, not representative performance, speedup, native workspace calibration, complete artifact-class I/O or backpressure qualification.
The complete 30,042,389-pair private dataset remains unrun through mix/verify/recover; the current prefix consumes 128 pairs per sample only.
Spawn workers, grants/IPC, deterministic parallel parser/terminal/sort integration and process crash/reaping acceptance remain outstanding.
Historical dev2 and dev3 results and archive hashes remain attached to their original candidates.

packaging.build_frontend: declared setuptools backend called directly; optional build frontend unavailable
packaging.documentation_finalization: One stale status paragraph in IMPLEMENTATION.md was corrected after wheel tests. The sdist was finalized again; the exact tested wheel and all runtime/tooling/test bytes stayed unchanged. Final archive members were compared with the recorded checkout fingerprints. This local development build is not the Plan 17A freeze.
